Test Case: 1

Test Case Title: Successful Appointment Booking with Valid Credentials and Details
Module: Appointment Booking
Priority: High

Preconditions:
- User has installed and can access the CURA Healthcare application.
- User has valid login credentials (username and password).
- Hongkong CURA Healthcare Center is available for booking.
- Medicaid healthcare program is available.
- A future visit date is selectable.

Test Steps:
1. Open the CURA Healthcare application.
2. Tap on the Make Appointment button.
3. Wait until the Username field is visible.
4. Enter "John Doe" as the username.
5. Wait until the Password field is visible.
6. Enter "ThisIsNotAPassword" as the password.
7. Tap on the Login button.
8. Wait until the Appointment Booking page is displayed.
9. Select "Hongkong CURA Healthcare Center" from the Facility dropdown.
10. Select "Medicaid" as the healthcare program.
11. Select a visit date in the future.
12. Enter "I have very high fever." in the comment field.
13. Review all appointment details.
14. Tap on the Book Appointment button.
15. Wait until the Appointment Confirmation page is displayed.
16. Verify that the healthcare facility is "Hongkong CURA Healthcare Center".
17. Verify that the healthcare program is "Medicaid".
18. Verify that the visit date matches the previously selected future date.
19. Verify that the comment is "I have very high fever".
20. Confirm that all displayed appointment information is correct.

Expected Result:
- The user is able to log in successfully.
- The Appointment Booking page is displayed after login.
- All appointment fields accept and display the selected/entered data correctly.
- The appointment is booked for the selected healthcare facility, program, date, and with the entered comment.
- The Appointment Confirmation page displays exact details as entered and selected by the user.
- The appointment booking process completes successfully.
